items.description: Шинэхэн моцарелла бяслаг, Сан Марцано улаан лооль, базилик, нэмэлт оливын тос

items.description: Зэрлэг мөөг, трюфель тос, фонтина бяслаг

items.description: Шарсан тахиа, BBQ сүмс, улаан сонгино, утсан гөүда бяслаг

items.name: Ceaser Salad

reviews.name: Sarah Johnson
reviews.text: Best pizza in town! The crust is perfectly crispy and the ingredients are always fresh. The Margherita is my favorite - simple but delicious.

reviews.name: Michael Chen
reviews.text: Great food and fast delivery. The truffle mushroom pizza was amazing. Only complaint is that the portions could be slightly larger for the price.

reviews.name: Emily Davis
reviews.text: Absolutely love this place! The wood-fired oven makes such a difference. Everything tastes authentic and the service is always friendly.

info.about: Authentic wood-fired pizza with fresh, locally-sourced ingredients. Family-owned since 1985.
